{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge V-neck sweater, fitted with a slightly cropped hem, long sleeves, deep burgundy #6D1F2E, merino wool
A-line midi skirt, falling just below the knee, dark chocolate #3E2B26, soft wool blend with a subtle woven texture
Single-breasted coat, straight cut, knee length, camel #B88B5A, brushed wool blend
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, espresso #2B1D18, smooth leather
Small structured crossbody bag, cognac #8B5A2B, leather
Small hoop earrings, gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat band: a refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots feels put-together without looking like you are trying too hard for a casual restaurant. The burgundy and chocolate are warm, rich autumn tones that glow in the soft artificial light of an evening dinner, and the knit gives you a flattering, romantic neckline. The midi skirt moves nicely when you walk and is comfortable for sitting through a long meal, while the low block heel keeps you steady. The camel coat adds warmth for the cool autumn evening and comes off easily at the table, and the gold hoops add just enough sparkle for a date."}
